patterns.message: UI cannot import from /app. The router instance and providers are dev-owned.
UI cannot import from the smart layer (api / store / controllers / models).
No cross-flow imports. Each flow owns its screens. Shared UI goes in src/shared/ui; shared mock data goes in src/flows/_mocks.
Inside /flows use relative imports for your own flow. Reaching another flow by alias is still a cross-flow import.
Flow folders nest at most 6 levels deep. Flatten this folder — past that depth the cross-flow ban cannot be checked.

forbid.message: Use <Button>. It carries the variant, size and focus-ring tokens.
Use <Select>, or <NativeSelect> when you want the OS control.
Use <Label>, or <Field> for a labelled control.
Use <Table>. (Prose tables inside .typeset are the exception — see AGENTS.md §3.)

no-restricted-syntax.message: No arbitrary colour values. Use a semantic token: bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-input.
No arbitrary colour values. Use a semantic token: bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-input.
No raw palette utilities (bg-blue-500). Use a semantic token, or add one to src/theme/theme.css.
No raw palette utilities (bg-blue-500). Use a semantic token, or add one to src/theme/theme.css.
No literal colours. Colour lives in src/theme/theme.css as an oklch custom property.
No literal colours. Colour lives in src/theme/theme.css as an oklch custom property.
No bg-white / text-black. Use bg-background, text-foreground, or bg-foreground for a scrim.
No bg-white / text-black. Use bg-background, text-foreground, or bg-foreground for a scrim.
No dynamic import() in presentation. Lazy loading and code-splitting are Dev's, in /app — import statically, and never another flow's screen.
No style prop. Use className with Tailwind utilities — that is the whole reason there is no *.styles.ts file in this pack.
